schema_findings.denver: SCHEDNUM is text in authoritative ArcGIS, numeric in Socrata mirror. D_CLASS is text, including alphanumeric codes. No NUM_BLDGS or building foreign key in inspected parcel extract; no parcel foreign key in roofprints. Public metadata supplied no detailed TOT_UNITS definition.
schema_findings.sf: number_of_units is numeric, described only as Number of units. No building-count field in roll. sf16_bldgid is unique; mblr is a prefixed property/ROW identifier, not directly parcel_number. mapblklot can be shared by condominium lots. existing_units and proposed_units in permits refer to the site.
schema_findings.sf_geometry_origin: Pictometry 2010 geometry, subsequently split/refined; later refresh/edit timestamps are not new acquisition dates.
